question: Can a save-level, verified ordinary-Furniture ADD make a normal Village generic ObjectLimit counter exceed the vanilla UI cap by exactly one and remain load/save/cold-relaunch stable without unrelated mutation?

nativePrerequisites.candidateWriter: promoted ordinary Furniture ADD through verified 01A structural candidate path only

baseline: one classifier-admissible ordinary counted Furniture ItemID is already in the Village unique set
destination cell is independently native-placement VALID
cases.mutation: add exactly one additional instance of that already-present ItemID
cases.isolation: Total Objects exceeds by one; Distinct Object Types does not newly exceed

baseline: choose one classifier-admissible ordinary counted Furniture ItemID absent from the Village unique set
destination cell is independently native-placement VALID
cases.mutation: add exactly one instance of the absent ItemID
cases.isolation: Distinct Object Types exceeds by one; Total Objects does not exceed

protocol: record exact source save hash, backup and target Village identity
independently recompute native-aligned baseline Unique/All from Village-related grids plus recursive SubGrids using the frozen count contract
verify ProfileWorld.ExtraLimitObject == false and reject the test if high-end limits are active
produce the one-object candidate only through the already-promoted ordinary Furniture ADD verified-export path
independently verify semantic diff contains only the one created GridObject plus exact NextGridObjectID increment
independently recompute candidate Unique/All and prove the requested +1 overflow/isolation before installing
install candidate through the existing controlled runtime-test replacement path
launch DDV and verify the save loads without recovery/reset and the added object exists at the intended location
do not use vanilla placement UI to add more objects; this request tests persistence, not UI-limit bypass behavior
perform a normal in-game save, fully exit the game process, cold relaunch, and verify the same object persists
re-export/re-read the save and recompute Unique/All; the over-limit counter must still be exactly the expected value with no automatic deletion/clamping
verify unrelated inventory/ownership/entitlement/Store/progression state is unchanged apart from independently classified normal game-time noise
restore the exact original backup in a separate recovery check and confirm load
pass: added object persists through normal save + full exit + cold relaunch
recomputed over-limit counter remains expected (+1) after relaunch
no automatic object deletion, counter normalization through content deletion, or unrelated semantic mutation
fail: load rejection/recovery/reset attributable to the candidate
added object is removed or transformed because the counter exceeds the cap
normal save or cold relaunch fails
post-relaunch semantic state falls back under cap through automatic content mutation
unrelated state changes beyond independently excluded normal runtime noise
